description: Independent Python reconstruction of concrete graph, family facts, and known-deletion case enumeration
command:
timeout 60s python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, resource
from collections import Counter
from itertools import combinations, product
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(55,55))
root=Path('computations/dd82/construction')
rows=[tuple(map(int,s.split())) for s in (root/'brown57.edges').read_text().splitlines()]
assert rows[0]==(57,224) and len(rows)==225
edges=rows[1:]
assert len(set(edges))==224 and all(0<=u<v<57 for u,v in edges)
a=[set() for _ in range(57)]
for u,v in edges:a[u].add(v);a[v].add(u)
P=[(1,u,v) for u in range(7) for v in range(7)]+[(0,1,u) for u in range(7)]+[(0,0,1)]
assert set(edges)=={(u,v) for u,v in combinations(range(57),2) if sum(x*y for x,y in zip(P[u],P[v]))%7==0}
C={v for v in range(57) if len(a[v])==7}
I={v for v in range(57) if v not in C and not a[v]&C}
E=set(range(57))-C-I
assert (len(C),len(I),len(E))==(8,21,28)
assert all(len(a[v])==8 for v in I|E)
assert all(a[v]<=E for v in C)
assert all((len(a[v]&C),len(a[v]&I))==(2,3) for v in E)
assert all(len(a[v]&I)==4 for v in I)
allT=[frozenset(t) for t in combinations(range(57),3) if all(v in a[u] for u,v in combinations(t,2))]
T=[t for t in allT if t<=I]
Q=[t for t in allT if len(t&I)==1 and len(t&E)==2]
assert (len(allT),len(T),len(Q))==(56,14,42)
assert all(sum(v in t for t in T)==sum(v in t for t in Q)==2 for v in I)
def typ(e):
 s=set(e)
 return 'II' if s<=I else 'CE' if s&C else 'IE' if s&I else 'EE'
counts=Counter(typ(e) for e in edges)
assert counts=={'II':42,'CE':56,'IE':84,'EE':42}
assert all(sum(set(e)<=t for t in allT)==(0 if typ(e)=='CE' else 1) for e in edges)
hist={}
family={}
for k in (6,7,8,9):
 f=list(combinations(range(14),k))
 hist[str(k)]=dict(sorted(Counter(len(set().union(*(T[q] for q in ix))) for ix in f).items()))
 family[k]=f
claimed=json.loads((root/'brown_r9_eight_iii_facts.json').read_text())
assert [[*sorted(t)] for t in T]==claimed['III_triangles']
assert json.loads(json.dumps(hist))==claimed['coverage_histograms']
six=0
for ix in family[6]:
 union=set().union(*(T[q] for q in ix))
 if len(union)!=18:continue
 six+=1;missing=I-union
 assert missing in T
 blocks=[T[q] for q in ix]+[{v}|(a[v]&E) for v in missing]
 assert sum(map(len,blocks))==len(set().union(*blocks))==33
 assert all(len(a[v]&E)==4 for v in missing)
 for v in missing:
  h={v}|(a[v]&E)
  assert sum(set(e)<=h for e in edges)==6
assert six==14
a7_19=cases19=0
for ix in family[7]:
 union=set().union(*(T[q] for q in ix))
 if len(union)!=19:continue
 a7_19+=1
 incidence=Counter(v for q in ix for v in T[q])
 R={v for v,c in incidence.items() if c==2}
 central=[q for q in ix if R<=T[q]]
 assert len(R)==2 and len(central)==1
 ct=T[central[0]]
 base=[T[q] for q in ix if q!=central[0]]
 assert len(set().union(*base))==18
 missing=I-union
 assert I-set().union(*base) in T
 assert len(missing)==2 and all(v in a[u] for u,v in combinations(missing,2))
 extra=[{v}|(a[v]&E) for v in sorted(missing)]
 for ce in combinations(sorted(ct),2):
  affected=[t for t in base if set(ce)&t]
  groups=extra+[t for t in base if not set(ce)&t]
  for choice in product(*[list(combinations(sorted(t),2)) for t in affected]):
   cases19+=1
   known=[ce,*choice]
   d=Counter(v for e in known for v in e)
   assert all(d[v]<=2 and (d[v]<2 or v in R) for v in d)
   assert sum(max(0,x-1) for x in d.values())<=2
   assert not (C|set(d))&set().union(*groups)
   assert sum(map(len,groups))==len(set().union(*groups))
assert (a7_19,cases19)==(42,630)
a7_21=cases21=0
types=Counter()
for ix in family[7]:
 base=[T[q] for q in ix]
 if len(set().union(*base))!=21:continue
 a7_21+=1
 extras=[e for e in edges if typ(e)!='II' or any(set(e)<=t for t in base)]
 assert len(extras)==203
 for e1,e2 in combinations(extras,2):
  ends=set(e1+e2)
  affected=[t for t in base if t&ends]
  groups=[t for t in base if not t&ends]
  assert len(affected)<=2
  opts=[[e for e in combinations(sorted(t),2) if e not in (e1,e2)] for t in affected]
  for choices in product(*opts):
   cases21+=1
   label='+'.join(sorted((typ(e1),typ(e2)),key=['II','CE','IE','EE'].index))
   types[label]+=1
   known=[e1,e2,*choices]
   assert len(set(known))==len(known)
   d=Counter(v for e in known for v in e)
   spare=sum(d[v]+int(v in C)-1 for v in set(d)|C)
   assert 0<=spare<=3
   assert not (set(d)|C)&set().union(set(),*groups)
assert (a7_21,cases21)==(2,145040)
assert dict(types)==json.loads((root/'brown_r9_a7_cover21.json').read_text())['cases_by_unordered_extra_edge_types']
full=twenty=alternatives=0
records=[]
for ix in family[8]:
 inc=Counter(v for q in ix for v in T[q])
 R={v for v,c in inc.items() if c==2}
 if len(inc)==21:
  full+=1
  assert len(R)==3 and sum(T[q]==R for q in ix)==1
 if len(inc)!=20:continue
 twenty+=1
 missing=next(iter(I-set(inc)))
 isolated=[T[q] for q in ix if not T[q]&R]
 assert len(R)==4 and len(isolated)==2
 Z=set().union(*isolated)
 assert len(Z)==6
 cross=[(u,v) for u in isolated[0] for v in isolated[1] if v in a[u]]
 assert len(cross)==1
 assert not any(a[v]&Z for v in R)
 assert all(len(a[v]&Z)<=1 for v in I-Z-{missing})
 ee=[e for e in edges if set(e)<=E and missing in a[e[0]]&a[e[1]]]
 assert len(ee)==2
 for u,v in ee:
  alternatives+=1
  assert not (a[u]|a[v])&Z
 records.append(dict(triangle_indices=list(ix),missing_I=missing,repeated_I=sorted(R),isolated_triangles=[sorted(t) for t in isolated],cross_edge=list(cross[0]),allowed_extra_EE_edges=[list(e) for e in ee]))
assert (full,twenty,alternatives)==(14,42,84)
assert records==claimed['records']
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',graph_edge_count=len(edges),graph_matches_explicit_F7_coordinates=True,class_sizes=dict(C=len(C),I=len(I),E=len(E)),edge_types=counts,triangle_counts=dict(III=len(T),IEE=len(Q)),coverage_histograms=hist,six_disjoint_families=six,seven_cover19_families=a7_19,seven_cover19_cases=cases19,seven_cover20_families=hist['7'].get(20,0),seven_cover21_families=a7_21,seven_cover21_cases=cases21,cases_by_unordered_extra_edge_types=types,eight_cover21_families=full,eight_cover20_families=twenty,eight_cover20_EE_alternatives=alternatives,all_author_family_records_match=True),indent=2))
